name: Check Balance
description: Signs on, looks up a member by ID, and reports their current checking and savings balance.
goal: Sign on as operator "demo_operator" with password "demo_password", look up member 10001, and extract and report their current checking balance and savings balance.

paramMappings.name: Operator ID
paramMappings.description: Operator ID used to sign on to the terminal.

paramMappings.name: Password
paramMappings.description: Operator password used to sign on to the terminal.

paramMappings.name: Member ID
paramMappings.description: The member whose balances to look up.

successCheckpoint.description: Reached the member detail page showing both balances.

knownOutcomes.name: member_not_found
knownOutcomes.description: No member exists with the given memberId. A legitimate result, not a crash.

knownOutcomes.name: permission_denied

detector.description: Operator lacks permission to view this member.

knownOutcomes.description: The signed-on operator is not permitted to view this member's balances.

knownOutcomes.name: session_timeout

detector.description: Session expired mid-flow, redirected to sign-on.

knownOutcomes.description: The operator session expired mid-flow; automation re-authenticates and retries the step once.

checkpoint.description: Reached the search page after signing on.
Reached the member detail page showing both balances.
